The superficial gas velocity is calculated as follows:
For apparatus condition 1 (coal combustion):
U = (PA/SA ratio × PA) / (density of air × cross-sectional area)
U = (0.8/0.2 × 12.00) / (1.2 kg/m^3 × 0.0125 m^2) = 1.3 m/s
For apparatus condition 2 (coal and NH3 20% co-firing):
U = (0.8/0.2 × 12.40) / (1.2 kg/m^3 × 0.0125 m^2) = 1.3 m/s

The superficial gas velocity used in the bubbling fluidized bed ammonia co-firing experiments was 1.3 m/s.
